summary: The registrant, KNOREX Ltd., filed a Form 6-K to distribute notice of an extraordinary general meeting requisitioned by shareholders holding ≥1/10 voting rights. The agenda includes resolutions to remove director Wilson Chandra and elect three new directors (Kai Zhong, Lu Liu, Truong Vinh Phu Le) effective immediately upon passage. No monetary terms, premium, or advisors are mentioned. The meeting is hybrid (physical/virtual) with a record date of June 12, 2026, and will be held June 24, 2026. The filing signals a shareholder-driven board shakeup, potentially activist in nature, rather than routine business. No deal terms present.
